title: Relief to Preity Zinta as Bombay High Court orders takedown of specified deepfakes, AI-generated content
description: The Bombay High Court today granted Bollywood actor Preity Zinta interim protection over her personality, publicity and moral rights against AI‑generated deepfake and morphed content, ordering the take down of various such posts [Preity Zinta v. Google LLC & Ors].Justice Madhav Jamdar also emphasised that online intermediaries such as Google, Meta and other social media websites cannot claim to be mere passive conduits in such matters, and that they too are obliged to act against such conten
